edbDesc: The effect of sonic waves and wave properties on chemical systems. Sonochemistry arises from acoustic cavitation: the formation, growth, and implosive collapse of bubbles in a liquid. This is demonstrated in phenomena such as ultrasound, sonication, sonoluminescence, and sonic cavitation.
title: Sonochemistry
pickWhy: A field of study (chemistry driven by ultrasound); its underlying effect is cavitation, covered in another batch.
